about_the_game:
This very first Busty Biz DLC introduces you to feisty Finn Anna, a gamer girl who has both beauty and brains.

She met Rose online and fell in love with her at first sight. This prompted her to leave her job as an accountant and start her lewd adventure alongside Rose and, well, you of course! But beware - Anna’s very competitive, so she’s sure to want to grab your attention at all times. She’s also a big fan of office roleplay, and has a teeny tiny kink for masturbating in semi-public places.

Purchase this DLC and unlock Anna, together with a special (SFW) wallpaper!
